title: Vortex patterns in a superconducting-ferromagnetic rod
verdict_basis: Reduced 2D-GL cross-section + z-layer-stack model reproduces the thickness-dependent MECHANISM: thin disk (D=2xi) -> centred giant vortex (W=2, core RMS 0.05 xi); thick rod (D=6xi) -> depth-varying winding (6->0) with |Psi|^2 rising toward bottom (Meissner retained). Does NOT reproduce the literal 3D curved vortex line or exact Table-1 mu-sequences.
